detail: ~35 lines differ only in the insert query and audit event; both parse row.id, call audit_log.create with the same details shape, and return Ok(True)/Ok(False)/Error. AGENTS.md mandates DRY extraction at 2+ repeats.
recommended_fix: Extract `insert_slot_and_audit(tx, insert_fn, audit_event, app, landlord, slot, name, phone, email)` parameterised on the insert fn and event.

title: find_live_row_for_slot and find_skipped_row_for_slot duplicate the list+filter scaffold
detail: Both helpers call list_reference_calls_for_application then list.find; they differ only in the status predicate. A shared predicate-parameterised lookup removes the duplication.
recommended_fix: Factor `find_row_for_slot(db, app, slot, predicate)` and pass `!is_terminal` / `== "skipped"`.

title: run_action_with_prechecks inherits handle_update_status's loose error handling, not handle_open's stricter pattern
detail: handle_open explicitly splits Error to 500 'so a transient DB blip can't fall through and bypass the archive guard'. The new precheck lumps verify_vacancy_active errors into `_ -> action()`, inheriting the flaw handle_open fixed.
recommended_fix: Follow handle_open's explicit Ok([row])/Ok(_)/Error three-way split for verify_vacancy_active instead of the catch-all.
